specification: Acceptance scenarios for the message guard, derived from the user stories in specs/conops.md. Any realization, in any language, must reproduce them. Each scenario is a story's example as data: one input message and the expected output, or null when the story expects nothing to leave.
assumes: A message is a security level and an integer payload (REQ-0). The guard is the filter stage alone (glossary: filter); the payload is not inspected (E-1).
governance: Never edited to make a test pass. A scenario that looks wrong is a gap about the pair (scenario, story): report it to the audit (procedure Audit) and rule on it there.
loader: tests/test_scenarios.py runs every scenario and cites the story it derives from (Scen-CONF-1).

scenarios.note: E-1: the payload is not inspected; a negative payload leaves like any other.
E-1: no clamping in this version; cutting a large payload down is deferred want D-2.

blind_spots: Only the listed payload values are checked; the requirements are universal over integers.
No scenario sends a malformed message; REQ-0 is verified by unit tests, not by scenarios.
